script:
onRoleReachedMoon = function() 
    game.pauseLogic()
	if global.getBool("lvl36_b1") then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		repeat
			sound.play("51-2")
		    if dialog.show("Level36-1", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level36-2", faceWunai) ==1 then break end
			if dialog.show("Level36-3", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
			sound.play("52-1")
			if dialog.show("Level36-4", faceRenzhen) ==1 then break end
			global.setBool("lvl36_b1")
		until true
		dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
    game.success()
end
